status: one-seed canonical direct-goal exposure diagnostic; not a headline result
metric_definition: D_Z(p) = score(correct Z, p) - score(shuffled Z, p)
interpretation: The expected smooth bypass curve is not observed: exact-match D_Z stays between .873 and .902 across the full direct-exposure range.
Shuffled-Z facet satisfaction remains near chance through p=.75 and improves only at p=1, showing that partial direct access does not replace the latent route for complete outputs.
At p=1, zero-Z facet satisfaction rises to .738, so direct tokens are usable when latent conditioning is absent, but the trained model still prefers the stronger late-layer Z route.
At p=1, counterfactual Z produces the complete Z-consistent output in .926 of cases despite conflicting direct goal tokens, demonstrating dominant top-down latent control rather than bypass.
Because exposure conditions are trained independently, this is a route-preference diagnostic with adaptation, not a pure inference-time intervention or a headline multi-seed result.
